text:
maria_ops: FYI vendor GlacierTech reported 8 units flagged as DOA from the FRA allocation. Thermal logs show short over-temp events on 3 serials. They've initiated RMA.
vincent_procurement: Which model/sku? Is this from our reserved FRA pool?
maria_ops: H200-XL units, booked to FRA dedicated pool (2Q commit). GlacierTech attached serial list in the email.
anya_sre: Losing 8 H200s in FRA will hit our latency SLOs for region-local customers. We run two throughput clusters on that pool; need mitigation plan now.
kai_logistics: Requested AWB and depot photos. GlacierTech provided AWB 1Z999EEU and a photo bundle (s3://glaciertech/claims/1717331234). RMA reference RT-8421.
maria_ops: Vendor proposed 3 options: (A) air-replace 3 units now (expedite, +$12k/unit premium) (B) depot rework 7-10d (cheaper) (C) credit and cross-region reallocate from US buffer.
vincent_procurement: Budget-wise air premium is nasty. Leo, any emergency cap?
leo_finance: We have contingency for critical infra but need a quantified impact to sign-off.
anya_sre: With traffic profile, a net loss of 8 H200s would bump 95p tail latency +18-25% on FRA clusters during peak micro-bursts. That likely causes SLO risk for two premium accounts. Cross-region re-route from US will add ~15-25ms p50 for those customers depending on policy.
vincent_procurement: Can we spin up Dedicated capacity in AMS as closer alternative? Any inventory from partners?
kai_logistics: AMS stock is thin. I've pinged two EU/APAC vendors. GlacierTech can air-split 3 immediately, next batch in ~9 days. NordicCompute replied with 5 units available but needs 72h staging + ~5d transit.
maria_ops: For rollback / route policy: prefer air-replace for critical customers, move dev/low-priority workloads to US buffer.
anya_sre: Also enable model fallback to quantized variants to reduce memory footprint temporarily. Adjust batching windows + KV TTL to avoid cache blowouts while capacity constrained.
vincent_procurement: Cost tradeoff calc: air-replace = +$36k, depot rework saves ~$20k but 7-10d risk window; NordicCompute is middle ground. If SLA credits or churn likely, air-replace may be cheaper overall.
leo_finance: If breach probability >60% approve emergency spend. What's current breach probability?
anya_sre: Forecast -> ~70% chance of breach in next 14 days without mitigation. With 3 air replacements + US buffer re-route drops to ~15%.
kai_logistics: GlacierTech uploaded serial photos + thermal CSVs. RMA RT-8421 accepted; initial status CREATED -> AWAITING_PICKUP. ETA dock receipt for air-replace 48-72h after ship. Requesting expedited customs clear — need signed paperwork.
rmabot: RMA RT-8421 status update: CREATED -> AWAITING_PICKUP. Pending actions: "customsForm_signed", "inspector_photos_received".
maria_ops: Kai, please attach signed customs form by EOD. I'll provision ops contingency pending finance signoff.
vincent_procurement: I'll cut a PO amendment (emergency) for 3-unit air-replace and hold NordicCompute 5 units as fallback.
leo_finance: Approve up to $40k emergency contingent on impact doc and final invoices. Tag me on the procurement incident doc.
anya_sre: Ops checklist I'm executing now: 1) enable quantized model fallback for FRA clusters 2) lower batching thresholds and increase KV TTLs 3) mark two premium customers for priority routing to any available pool 4) update incident dashboard with capacity delta.
maria_ops: I'll coordinate with ENG-Platform for routing policy updates and Solutions for customer comms.
kai_logistics: Uploaded signed customs (s3://redwood/shipments/1717331234/customs_signed.pdf) and AWB paperwork. GlacierTech scheduled pickup 12:30 UTC.
vincent_procurement: PO amendment PO-3087-EMG created. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PO-3087
leo_finance: Maria, file annotated impact note in the procurement incident doc and loop me in.
maria_ops: On it.
anya_sre: Quick canary results — after enabling quantized fallback we saw ~12% reduction in p95 tail in test. Keeping fallback for 10 days and re-evaluating once replacements land.
kai_logistics: GlacierTech updated RMA RT-8421 -> IN_TRANSIT. AWB 1Z999EEU departed FRA hub. ETA to depot 2024-05-05 09:00 CEST.
vincent_procurement: NordicCompute still holding 5 units until EOD; will confirm hold if GlacierTech misses ETA.
maria_ops: Closing loop: primary = air-replace 3 units (GlacierTech) + US buffer re-route + quantized fallback. NordicCompute reserved as fallback. Logging actions in incident channel. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
